title: Decent Small LED Lights
text:
Decent Small LED Lights. I used these lights within a cabinet for under a couple pieces of art and they worked ok with modifications.

All of my lighting, similar to these is operated via smart plugs and switches. Due to the only way to turn these on being the control located on the wire, I had to remove that to make it work for my purposes. This made it so the light was not dimmable but it has worked for what I wanted.

Personally I would prefer if both the color of light in the set matched as I assume they will typically be used together.

All in all they are ok but not great.
